acceptance.item: P5-RT-12-01: npm run report presents the report of an earlier release build when the latest release build failed in the prebuild step
acceptance.test: site/tests/unit/report-prebuild-failure.test.ts > npm run report refuses the report of an earlier release build when the latest release build failed in the prebuild (also: > a link check run by hand after a release build that failed in the prebuild does not complete the earlier report)
acceptance.evidence: Severity minor (no verifier adjustment). Red at base 3f9bb33: 3 failed | 2 passed (5), with 'report: open items report of 2026-10-25T05:42:55.612Z: 1 open items used on 1 pages, 0 unknown items; ...: expected +0 to be 1', which is the observed exit 0 with the earlier report. The test runs the root prebuild line by the shell, as npm does, in a scratch copy of the repository, and that line fails in its first command. Green: 5 passed. Cause: the report was held as incomplete only from astro:build:start on, so nothing marked it before the prebuild, which DECISIONS.md RT-FIX-P4-toolchain counts as part of the release build. Fix: holdForReleaseBuild in site/src/lib/openItemsReport.mjs is now the first statement of scripts/katex-assets.mjs, the first command of the prebuild. In a release build it marks an existing release report complete:false and drops its linkCheck. The test bites under two mutations: the hold moved after the KaTeX copy gives 3 failed, and keeping linkCheck gives 1 failed. Rerunning the lens reproducer after the fix: step 3 exit 1 in the prebuild, step 4 npm run report exit 1 with 'did not finish'. The P4-RT-12-04 tests pass unchanged. Release build and npm run report: exit 0. Commit f6f395a.

handoff: scripts/katex-assets.mjs (P0-A3's script, the first command of the prebuild) now imports site/src/lib/openItemsReport.mjs and calls holdForReleaseBuild before it looks for KaTeX. Root package.json, the prebuild line (asserted exactly by scripts.test.ts) and scripts/report.mjs are unchanged. I followed the first proposedFix and did not add a marker file for report.mjs. When the lens reruns redteam-RT-12-stale-report.sh, step 4 should exit 1. After a prebuild failure, the existing wording of the refusal ('comes from a release build that did not finish') and of the Markdown 'Incomplete' line describes the latest release build, not the earlier build that wrote the report; I left the wording as it was because tests assert 'did not finish'. One engine-suite run failed 1 of 2411 while it ran alongside astro check and fixture builds (load about 11); no engine file changed, and the rerun alone passed 2411.
